title: Development and reports — UI design only

steps.headline: 1. Find reporting, contributing and the roadmap in one place.
steps.changed: A friendlier introduction explains why to contribute; the roadmap opens the canonical file rather than a duplicated list.
steps.notice: Existing product names stay unchanged. The pinned GitHub issue is not created by this design.
steps.risk: Design review only: external actions are disabled, not working backend functionality.

steps.headline: 2. Learn how an idea becomes a public proposal.
steps.changed: The information button explains conversation, design, isolated preview, checks and your explicit approval.
steps.notice: Private backup is not publishing, and your installed app stays untouched. The picture shows the scrolled walkthrough.
steps.risk: Design review only: external actions are disabled, not working backend functionality.

steps.path: Development → Report a Bug or Request a Feature
steps.headline: 3. Write and review your report without waiting for AI.
steps.changed: An editable title and description come first, with a public-sharing notice and optional error details.
steps.notice: This is a filled UI preview. No diagnostics or version information is collected yet.
steps.risk: Design review only: external actions are disabled, not working backend functionality.

steps.path: Report → Include recent logs → Review report
steps.headline: 4. Review optional logs before choosing AI help.
steps.changed: Logs start off, with a plain explanation of what they contain. Optional AI help appears only after review.
steps.notice: Sample text is editable, but logs are not read and AI is disabled. The scrolled picture shows the disclosure; selection remains above it.
steps.risk: Design review only: external actions are disabled, not working backend functionality.

steps.path: Report → Add screenshots or files in GitHub
steps.headline: 5. Know when attaching a file makes it leave your device.
steps.changed: The warning explains that GitHub uploads on attachment, before final submission.
steps.notice: You would review and attach approved files yourself in the browser. Export, upload and browser handoff are unbuilt.
steps.risk: Design review only: external actions are disabled, not working backend functionality.

steps.headline: 6. Set up a separate project without disturbing existing folders.
steps.changed: An example and the first setup action lead the screen. Project files, setup and private backup remain distinct.
steps.notice: Local-only work is offered if backup is unavailable. All setup and backup buttons are disabled UI proposals.
steps.risk: Design review only: external actions are disabled, not working backend functionality.

steps.path: Report → Review report → Preview a submission error
steps.headline: 7. Keep your draft while recovering from a report error.
steps.changed: A clearly labelled example error offers Retry without clearing the title, description or selected sample logs.
steps.notice: This is a local mock error, not a service request. Back and close retain this mounted draft; reloading still clears it.
steps.risk: Design review only: external actions are disabled, not working backend functionality.
